propositions: The test monkeypatch closure observed_upsert() has a narrower signature than the real CriterionBank.upsert(), rejecting keyword arguments evidence_sufficient and seeded that production code legitimately passes.

When the completion verifier runs under the monkeypatch and hits the bounded-fallback recovery path, it calls upsert(..., evidence_sufficient=False), causing the narrow observed_upsert stub to raise TypeError, surfaced as LLMError 'did not produce a verdict'.

The bedrock LLM arm triggers the bounded-fallback path (record_insufficient) due to timing, while anthropic/openai arms gathered sufficient evidence and bypassed it, explaining why the TypeError is bedrock-arm-specific.
The fix threads **kwargs through observed_upsert to forward all keyword arguments unchanged to the real upsert, preserving evidence_sufficient/seeded signal and maintaining signature parity.
A shared helper tests/_bank_observer.py::make_observed_upsert extracts the corrected stub for reuse across live and unit regression tests.
Unit regression tests/unit/test_completion_bank_observer_forwarding.py validates that evidence_sufficient and seeded kwargs flow through without TypeError, with no live credentials required.
